gloss: new work, new creation, latest release

definitions.gloss: new work, new creation, latest release
definitions.explanation: A newly created or recently released work, such as a movie, book, clothing item, or other product.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：00132_eiga⟧。
{新作|しんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドレス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}された→発表：03562_happyou⟧。

notes:
{新作|しんさく} refers to something newly created or released.

CONTRAST:
- {新作|しんさく}: new work (creation)
- {旧作|きゅうさく}: old work
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece
